raw: {"analysis": "MVP provides a clearer, more structured plan that correctly sequences the approvals, build, staging validation, and production authorization. It properly handles the flaky network-policy check, includes a solid rollback protocol, and defines clear completion criteria. GQB has some confusing elements, like batching services in groups of 3 to match build concurrency limits (which is irrelevant for deployment), and the gate numbering (G4/G5/G6) is inconsistent and unclear. MVP's plan is more actionable and better aligned with the constraints.", "verdict": "MVP"}
